objectives: “This course introduces students to communication skills needed for clear and successful interpersonal relationships in the professional world. The course addresses the importance of oral presentations in interviews and in the workplace. The course is designed to help students reflect on and narrate their college training, extra-curriculum activities, and work experience, preparing students for the upcoming challenges in the job market. We will work on different forms of presentation skills that help you build your professional profile.“

grading_policy:
“1. Weekly attendance and participation: 20％
2. Six individual oral presentation: 30％
3. One individual TED Talk presentation: 10％
4. One group presentation: 10％
5. One mock interview: 20％
6. Final group project presentation: 10％“
